summary: Full visual re-theme regression for MapMyCareer (dark→light professional). Landing renders correctly on desktop (1920) and mobile (390) with the new light palette, Inter font, brand 'MapMyCareer', new hero headline ('Most Students Will Spend 4 Years Preparing For Careers That AI May Change.'), dual CTA (hero-cta + hero-sample), 4 Recharts SVGs in the HeroDashboard (2 gauges, salary area, skill-gap bars), trust band with 4 checkmarks + 6 payment badges + 'Secured by Razorpay', How-it-works (3 steps), Features (6 cards), Sample Report tease with 'Unlock Full Personalized Report', Segments (B.Tech/BCA/B.Com/MBA/MCA/Fresh Graduates), Testimonials (3 with student photos + stars + verified badge), Pricing (₹499→₹199), 5-item FAQ accordion (expand/collapse), dark final-CTA + dark footer. The View Sample Report (hero-sample) smooth-scrolls to the Sample Report (#preview) section. Mobile sticky CTA appears at 390px after scroll and starts the funnel. The full funnel still works post re-theme: hero-cta → Student questionnaire (6 steps incl. Dream Career 'Game Developer') → analyze → result-headline → unlock → light-themed LeadGate (validation triggers lead-error on empty name and on <10-digit number, then POST /api/lead 200) → PaymentModal (mock) → 'Pay ₹199 Securely' → full premium report (Pros / Cons / Recommendation / Year 1 / Roadmap text present) → 'Download PDF' button visible. 0 React console errors throughout. WhatsApp FAB still present.
action_items: (Optional) Consider raising z-index of [data-testid="whatsapp-fab"] above 50 in the preview env so the Emergent badge does not overlap it (already documented in iteration_10 — preview-only collision).
After test sign-off, restore PAYMENT_MODE to live (remove env override) so real Razorpay flow resumes. Currently mock.
critical_code_review_comments: Landing.jsx (329 lines) packs Nav + Hero + TrustBand + How + Features + ReportTease + Segments + SocialProof + Pricing + FAQ + FinalCta + Footer in one file — still well below the 700-line threshold but consider per-section files if it grows further.
HeroDashboard.jsx uses 4 Recharts ResponsiveContainers; rendering is fine but consider isAnimationActive=false on charts inside the LCP path to keep landing TTI snappy on low-end mobiles.

LeadGate continues to swallow /api/lead failures silently (try/empty catch) so pre-payment leads can be lost if backend is down — consider a single retry or localStorage queue (carryover from iteration_10).

The 'Pay' substring on payment method tabs (UPI: GPay·PhonePe·Paytm, Wallets: Paytm·Amazon Pay) makes button:has-text('Pay') match 4+ tabs in addition to the submit button — non-blocking for users, only a testing-selector hygiene note. Prefer data-testid="pay-submit" on the actual Pay ₹199 Securely button for stronger automation.
seed_data_creation: Created one TEST_ lead via /api/lead through LeadGate and one TEST submission via /api/analyze + mock /verify-payment during E2E run. No production data touched.
